Method of Attack: Privilege escalation exploiting two Active Directory domain service vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-42287 and CVE-2021-42278) allowing attackers to impersonate domain controllers and elevate privileges to Domain Admin
Impacted Systems: Windows domains with Active Directory domain services
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Active Directory domain service privilege escalation vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Abnormal device name changes detected via Defender for Identity advanced hunting query
Windows Event 4741 for creator of new machines
